image_description: A flat-lay photograph displaying four vintage comic book covers arranged in a grid. The top-left cover features an orange alien creature; the top-right shows a superhero figure in blue and red; the bottom-left depicts a green monster-like character; and the bottom-center/bottom area shows a group of soldiers or characters in action poses. The image captures the glossy texture of the paper and the vibrant, albeit aged, colors of the print.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects clearly exhibit the standard rectangular aspect ratio of comic books. While the staples themselves are not visible due to the angle (covers are facing up), the physical form factor matches the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Light reflections on the surface confirm a glossy finish. Each item features distinct illustrated artwork and prominent, stylized title text at the top or bottom.
The spines are either hidden by the overlapping arrangement or facing away from the camera. It is impossible to visually verify staple marks from this perspective.

artifact_observations.location: Title areas and speech bubbles across all four covers
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is structurally nonsensical. While it mimics the shape of letters, it does not form readable words (e.g., 'GARGANTUA' is distorted, other titles are alien-like scribbles). This is a hallmark AI generation artifact where the model replicates the texture of text without understanding orthography.

There is slight 'smearing' or softness around the complex edges of the characters (especially the green monster's limbs), lacking the crisp ink lines typical of printed comics. The halftone dot pattern expected in vintage comics is inconsistent or missing, replaced by smooth digital gradients.

The anatomy of the soldier/character on the right side of the bottom cover is ambiguous. Limbs seem to merge with the background or other figures, and the weapon/object held is indistinct and structurally unclear.
